-- 创建公共信件表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_letters (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  letterId INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  excerpt VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  emotionTags JSON,
  starCount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (letterId) REFERENCES letters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (userId) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- 创建共鸣互动表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stars (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  publicLetterId INT NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_star (userId, publicLetterId),
  FOREIGN KEY (userId) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (publicLetterId) REFERENCES public_letters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- 创建每日一句表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS daily_quotes (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  letterId INT NOT NULL,
  quote VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  emotionTags JSON,
  date DATE NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (letterId) REFERENCES letters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- 创建时间胶囊表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS time_capsules (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  content TEXT NOT NULL,
  openDate DATETIME NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('pending', 'opened') DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  autoReply TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  openedAt TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (userId) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- 创建情绪星球表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS emotion_stars (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  letterId INT NOT NULL,
  emotionType VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  color VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  x DECIMAL(10, 4) NOT NULL,
  y DECIMAL(10, 4) NOT NULL,
  z DECIMAL(10, 4) NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (letterId) REFERENCES letters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- 更新letters表添加新字段
ALTER TABLE letters ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS emotionTags JSON;
ALTER TABLE letters ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS isPublic BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL;
